//: The project previously had three build profiles and nothing else: no submit
section, no channels, no native build numbering, and no expo-updates. Every
fix needed a full store review, two builds could not be told apart, and a bad
release could not be pulled back.
appVersionSource 'remote' means EAS owns the native build numbers, so iOS
buildNumber and Android versionCode must NOT be written into app.config.js —
EAS would ignore them and the two sources would drift. 'autoIncrement' is the
mechanism that belongs with remote versioning: EAS bumps the stored number on
every build, so no two binaries ever carry the same one and App Store Connect
and Play Console both accept consecutive uploads.
Channels bind a binary to an update stream at BUILD time. A production binary
only ever receives updates published to the production channel; nothing a
developer publishes to preview or development can reach a customer's phone.
NO CREDENTIAL BELONGS IN THIS FILE. The Apple values below are read from the
environment at submit time, and the Google Play service-account key is held by
EAS (eas credentials) rather than committed. See H77RELEASE.md.
